findings.oracle: test_apply_anti_evasion_dispatches_only_allowlisted_commands drives real apply_anti_evasion against a non-mock _RecordingAgent and asserts every dispatched command passes the independent is_windows_allowlisted helper and equals WINDOWS_REG_EXE_PATH, instead of asserting the constant against itself.

Kept as the allowlist-oracle boundary guard test_allowlist_oracle_rejects_bare_reg_exe_accepts_system32 (bare reg.exe -> False, System32 path -> True) and combined with the end-to-end dispatch test that proves the sandbox never emits bare reg.exe.

Real apply_anti_evasion run; asserts len(sent_commands) >= 5 and exactly 4 reg.exe 'add' dispatches, each command == WINDOWS_REG_EXE_PATH and allowlisted; asyncio.run is unwrapped so exceptions are fatal. Empty-dispatch can no longer pass silently.

test_apply_anti_evasion_records_full_technique_set asserts result keys == {profile,techniques,count}, exact types, count==len(techniques), all four launch techniques present, exactly 4 registry_patch + 1 mac_address_randomize, and total == launch+4+1; the sibling rejecting-agent test proves the count is not hardcoded.

Replaced by parametrized test_launch_smbios_type1_matches_required_identity that builds the real QEMU argv via _build_qemu_command, parses the -smbios type=1 entry, and asserts manufacturer/product == independent module-level _EXPECTED_IDENTITY (hand-maintained, separate from the production mapping).

No longer compares two helper methods. test_launch_smbios_type1_matches_required_identity decodes the literal -smbios launch string and checks it against the independent _EXPECTED_IDENTITY spec, so a shared-but-wrong production dict fails the test.

test_registry_writes_use_required_identity drives real apply_anti_evasion and asserts the dispatched reg.exe /d SystemManufacturer/SystemProductName values == independent _EXPECTED_IDENTITY (not _anti_evasion_identity), exactly one write each.

test_launch_smbios_and_registry_agree_with_each_other threads each profile through both real consumers (the -smbios launch arg and the reg.exe dispatch) and asserts spec==SMBIOS==registry triple-equality against the independent _EXPECTED_IDENTITY, not method-to-method equality.
